notes: GitHub and Playwright MCP are assumed to be available by default and are not redefined here.
Configure these servers for the coding agent in repo Settings > Copilot > Coding agent > MCP servers.
Any credential the coding agent needs must be stored as a repository secret whose name starts with COPILOT_MCP_ (for example COPILOT_MCP_AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET).
Replace every TODO placeholder with real values before enabling optional servers.

authentication.notes: Notion's hosted MCP uses interactive OAuth sign-in; authorize the connection in the GitHub Copilot MCP UI rather than storing a static token in this file.

notion.notes: Hosted Notion MCP endpoint confirmed. Set enabled to true after authorizing the connection in repo Settings > Copilot > Coding agent > MCP servers.

microsoft-learn.notes: Public, no-authentication Microsoft Learn MCP for grounded Microsoft 365, Graph, and SharePoint documentation lookups. Useful when configuring the SharePoint/OneDrive integration.

web-research.notes: Use for target-client research, signal scans, and current-events verification.

microsoft-graph-sharepoint.notes: No turnkey hosted SharePoint/OneDrive MCP exists for the GitHub coding agent yet; this needs an Azure AD (Entra) app registration with Microsoft Graph permissions plus a Graph MCP endpoint. Store the secrets above as repo secrets prefixed COPILOT_MCP_. Treat as a later step; use the microsoft-learn server above for setup guidance.
